conbody.p: If you select Highway Lane Change Assist, the function can help you change lanes safely.

note.p: For your safety, change the settings only after parking the vehicle at a safe location.

li.p: Towing a trailer or installing a carrier may reduce control stability. If necessary, disable the function and always drive with caution.
Do not use the system when towing another vehicle or when other equipment that affects sensor operation or vehicle balance is installed, as it may not operate properly.

The Highway Lane Change Assist function (if equipped) may not operate properly when a trailer, carrier, or other equipment is installed, or when towing another vehicle. Do not use the function in these cases.
To use Highway Lane Change Assist, Highway Driving Assist must be active.

If there is a problem with the Highway Lane Change Assist function, you cannot change the settings and should have the vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
The Highway Driving Assist and Highway Lane Change Assist functions maintain their last settings when you restart the vehicle.
When towing a trailer or installing a carrier, vehicle stability may be reduced. Disable the function if necessary and always drive safely with caution.
Do not use the system when towing another vehicle or when installing equipment that may affect sensor performance or vehicle balance. The system may not operate properly.

When connecting a trailer or carrier, set the trailer or carrier menu (if equipped). If the driver manually sets the menu or the trailer or carrier connection is automatically recognized through genuine parts, the functions of the driver assistance system may be limited. Please refer to and always drive with caution.
